_comment: Batch 01 — first five TikTok verticals. Naming: b<batch>-v<nn>_<hookId from hooks.md>_<moment m1-m4 or tNN tour chapter>_<format>. Clips are src:start:end[:cropY0:cropY1] on the source's own pixel grid (promo.mp4 is 402x874 with a 48 px caption strip at the bottom — crop 0:826 removes it; m*.webm are 390x844). All footage is real gameplay from marketing/videos and marketing/m*.webm; narration lines are the cached ElevenLabs cache in marketing/narration (voice Adam).
